openingStories.title: 线轴回来了

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: You and your companion are making a string of little flags. Suddenly, the spool rolls under a chair. The thread curls across the floor.
beats.translation: 你和同行者坐在桌边串小旗。线轴忽然滚到椅子下面，长线绕成了一个圈。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: Your companion gently moves the chair, and you pick up the spool. You each hold one end and slowly straighten the thread.
beats.translation: 同行者轻轻移开椅子，你伸手捡回线轴。你们各拿一头，慢慢把线理顺。

beats.text: The last little flag is in place. You hang the flags by the window, then sit together and watch them sway.

beats.translation: 你想把亲手画的小画收进盒子，可画纸宽了一点，怎么放也放不平。

beats.speaker: 旁白

beats.translation: 同行者扶住盒盖。你把画轻轻放上去，发现大小刚刚好，便一起把画贴牢。
